title: When the Vehicle Is Stuck: Noticing It Without Crying Wolf, a Ladder of Things to Try Per Vehicle, and Knowing When to Give Up

artifact.note: recovery from being stuck: a detector that says stuck when the vehicle has been commanded to move for a whole window and has moved less than a distance, a ladder of behaviours chosen by the number of attempts and what the vehicle can do (wait, back up, spin, give up), a state machine that runs one behaviour to its end or to a time limit and goes back to normal, forgets the attempts once the vehicle has made real progress, and gives up after a number of tries
